deploybot: Production deploy started for service=ingest-api env=prod
commit=feature/events-v2 tag=release/ingest-api@2026-03-20 sha=ffa1d3b8
plan: canary 5% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100%; small schema migration (events.v2) with online migration path

elena: @samir quick Q — any expected user-visible downtime during the migration?

samir: @elena no DB downtime expected, migration uses background adapter. Keep an eye on write latencies for 10m.

marco: Noting we pinned dedicated pool for canary to gpu-pool-eu1 to avoid noisy neighbors.

deploybot: Canary started: 5% traffic -> 3 pods (canary) 
canary_id=cb-1932500000 sha=ffa1d3b8
logs: `kubectl logs -l canary=cb-1932500000 -n prod | tail -n 50`

monitoring-bot: [metric alert] ingest-api write_latency_p95 rose to 240ms on canary pods at +6m (threshold 200ms) — alert id=mon-8812

marco: saw that spike, digging. It looks like GC pressure on one canary instance, OOM_killer not triggered. Restarting that pod now.

elena: can we pause the rollout until we confirm it's just one instance? Suggest hold at 5% until stable for another 5m.

samir: agree with hold. pausing traffic promotion. I'll run a quick smoke against realtime ingestion and verify event ordering.

deploybot: Rollout paused at 5% by @samir (reason: latency spike)

marco: restarted pod, GC tunables adjusted on the instance. New pod healthy. p95 back to ~120ms after restart.

monitoring-bot: incident cleared: ingest-api write_latency_p95 back under 200ms for canary group after +3m

samir: ran smoke tests: ingestion ok, migrations applied without conflicts on canary DB replica. ordering and idempotency checks passed. recommending proceed.

elena: thanks. proceed when ready.

deploybot: Canary marked healthy; proceeding to 50% traffic -> scaling to 12 pods across eu/us clusters; expected transition 2m

product: Heads up to support: release notes draft pushed — new events.v2 schema, consumers should be compatible but we flagged breaking-change checklist to partners.

deploybot: Traffic shift to 50% complete. No errors in rollout hook.

marco: small blip in p95 during shift but stabilized quickly. infrastructure looks good.

deploybot: Beginning final promotion to 100% traffic; old version will be drained with graceful timeout 60s

deploybot: Production deploy complete for service=ingest-api env=prod
commit=ffa1d3b8 tag=release/ingest-api@2026-03-20
start_ts=1932500000 end_ts=1932500123 duration=123s
notes: canary pause due to transient latency spike resolved by pod restart; migration completed online; no rollback required.

release-manager: Rolling release notes and changelog entries updated. Will notify enterprise customers now. :shipit:

elena: great work, team. I'll keep monitor dashboards open for next hour and report anything odd.

samir: I'll follow up with a short postmortem if anything shows up else we can close this thread in 1h.

product: Thanks — coordinating customer comms.
